input.patient: The patient was seen in a preconception visit while planning pregnancy and was not currently pregnant. There was no postpartum follow-up context. Preconception counseling addressed excess weight, with a body mass index of 31 kg/m², and the patient was actively pursuing a target weight loss of 5% and had achieved approximately a 5% reduction from baseline. As part of preconception metabolic management, impaired glucose tolerance and type 2 diabetes were assessed with a 75‑g oral glucose tolerance test performed at the preconception visit. The primary clinical focus was management.
